score: mean of up to three non-overlapping 10-second chroma segment matches
interpretation_note: The positive files are excerpts/transforms of the same source recording. Safe files are compared only with their CLAP Top-1 candidate. Chroma reflects pitch-class energy and harmonic patterns; this experiment is not a legal plagiarism verdict. The current segment comparison is time-aligned and transposition-tolerant but has no DTW tempo alignment.
